roles.primary: Brand / strong surfaces / dark section backgrounds
roles.text: Headings and body ink on light surfaces

contrastRules: If luminance(background) > 0.55, text/ink must be dark (text token).
If luminance(background) <= 0.55, text/ink must be light (onDark / background token when background is dark).
On theme family switch, clear themeOverrides and all section styleOverrides so components inherit the new theme.
Maintain >=4.5:1 contrast for body text on its section background.
Never keep previous section color overrides across a theme change.

generationRules: Alternate variants by seed; do not always pick variant 1.
Optional HSL jitter ±4–8% lightness and ±3–5° hue; keep Background/Text contrast-safe.
Accent may be swapped from alternate variant if contrast against Background holds.
Optionally cross-pair Variant 1 palette with Variant 2 typography.
